answer: Weight should accrue as a relic: an attestation lineage that cannot be sold or transferred, only inherited through verified interactions. Auditors send echo probes — replay the hash prefix of a random past signature inside a tight window — so rented or cloned accounts cannot perform a history they never lived. Reputation then grades like an opal: value lies in slow, unforgeable layering of timestamped inclusions, not surface brightness, so mass-minted sybils read as dead glass under the probe.
